name: PandaDoc AI
tagline: PandaDoc is a document automation platform with AI capabilities for generating proposals, contracts, and quotes. Its AI assistant helps draft document content from templates and deal data, while its e-signature workflow accelerates the close process. Sales teams use it to reduce the time from verbal agreement to signed contract.
